subject.title: [Feature]: Channel plugin threading policy for automatic subagent parameter injection

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-owned `sessions_spawn` auto-injection policy, or keep explicit `thread`/`mode` arguments and solve this through existing conversation bindings plus the broader persistent-session work?
rationale: The request changes plugin SDK semantics, model-facing tool defaults, and channel routing behavior; automation cannot safely choose those cross-channel defaults without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Design a narrow channel policy seam
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved SDK/session policy that expresses when a channel may default subagent spawns into thread-bound sessions, then migrate bundled channels and docs together.

options.title: Fold into persistent-session decoupling
options.body: Keep this open as dependent on the broader decision in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53548 before adding any auto-injection behavior.

options.title: Keep explicit parameters only
options.body: Document that agents must request `thread: true` and `mode: "session"` explicitly, avoiding any automatic channel-specific spawn behavior.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow channel policy seam
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved SDK/session policy that expresses when a channel may default subagent spawns into thread-bound sessions, then migrate bundled channels and docs together.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent core thread-binding refactor makes this primarily a core session-binding policy decision.
